# quickwit_source_sqs (Resource)

A file source fed by an SQS queue: each message points to a file (on S3 or another object store) to index.

Quickwit checks that it can reach the source when it is created or updated. Sources are deleted together with their index: when the index is replaced, add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [quickwit_index.<name>] }` so the source is recreated in the same apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Index the files announced by S3 event notifications.
resource "quickwit_source_sqs" "this" {
  index_id     = quickwit_index.logs.index_id
  source_id    = "sqs-source"
  queue_url    = "https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/quickwit-logs"
  message_type = "s3_notification"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_id` (String) Index the source feeds. Changing it recreates the source.
- `message_type` (String) Message format: `s3_notification` (S3 event notifications) or `raw_uri` (the message body is the file URI).
- `queue_url` (String) SQS queue URL. Its host is used as the SQS endpoint, so LocalStack URLs work.
- `source_id` (String) Source identifier, unique within the index. Changing it recreates the source.

### Optional

- `deduplication_cleanup_interval_secs` (Number) Interval, in seconds, between cleanups of the deduplication window. Defaults to `60`.
- `deduplication_window_duration_secs` (Number) How long, in seconds, processed files are remembered to deduplicate messages. Defaults to `3600`.
- `deduplication_window_max_messages` (Number) Maximum number of files remembered for deduplication. Defaults to `100000`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is indexed. Defaults to `true`.
- `input_format` (String) Format of the messages: `json`, `plain_text`, `otlp_logs_json`, `otlp_logs_protobuf`, `otlp_traces_json`, `otlp_traces_protobuf`. Defaults to `json`.
- `num_pipelines` (Number) Number of indexing pipelines. Defaults to `1`.
- `transform` (Attributes) [VRL](https://vector.dev/docs/reference/vrl/) transform applied to each document before indexing. Not supported with OTLP input formats. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<index_id>:<source_id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--transform"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform`

Required:

- `script` (String) VRL program, e.g. `.message = downcase(string!(.message))`.

Optional:

- `timezone` (String) TZ database timezone used by VRL time functions. Defaults to `UTC`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <index_id>:<source_id>.
terraform import quickwit_source_sqs.this logs:sqs-source
```
